col_acorn_carved.name: Carved acorn
col_acorn_carved.desc: A tiny face carved into it.

col_antler_tine.name: Antler tine
col_antler_tine.desc: A tip snapped from a shed antler.

col_blighted_bloom.name: Petrified bloom
col_blighted_bloom.desc: A rose turned to grey stone. It's cold.

col_blue_jay_feather.name: Blue jay feather
col_blue_jay_feather.desc: Blue on one side, grey on the other.

col_bone_charm.name: Bone charm
col_bone_charm.desc: A carved knot of bone on a thong.

col_carved_bird.name: Carved wooden bird
col_carved_bird.desc: One of her father's figures, unsold.

col_dandelion_clock.name: Faelight seed head
col_dandelion_clock.desc: Held carefully, it glows for a day.

col_glass_bead.name: Sea-green glass bead
col_glass_bead.desc: Fae work: there is a light inside it.

col_heart_stone.name: Heart-shaped stone
col_heart_stone.desc: She'd scoff at it. She keeps it.

col_horseshoe.name: Old horseshoe
col_horseshoe.desc: Iron. Villagers nail these over doors.

col_leaf_gilded.name: Gilded leaf
col_leaf_gilded.desc: Real gold leaf, or a glamour.

col_mask_shard.name: Mask shard
col_mask_shard.desc: A chip of gilded mask from the revels.

col_mural_chip.name: Mural chip
col_mural_chip.desc: Painted plaster from the old shrines: a human hand in chains.

col_odd_stone.name: Odd stone
col_odd_stone.desc: A stone with a hole worn clean through.

col_old_arrowhead.name: Old arrowhead
col_old_arrowhead.desc: Iron, rusted, from some hunt long ago.

col_painted_pebble.name: Painted pebble
col_painted_pebble.desc: Someone painted a tiny flower on it. Maybe her, years ago.

col_ribbon_scrap.name: Ribbon scrap
col_ribbon_scrap.desc: A bit of Nesta's ribbon. She'd never admit it was hers.

col_river_glass.name: River glass
col_river_glass.desc: Frosted green glass, smooth as soap.

col_robin_egg_shell.name: Robin's egg shell
col_robin_egg_shell.desc: The exact blue she can never mix.

col_seed_packet.name: Elain's seed packet
col_seed_packet.desc: Paper twist of seeds for a garden that might grow.

col_silver_leaf.name: Silver leaf
col_silver_leaf.desc: A leaf that dried silver instead of brown.

col_snail_spiral.name: Spiral shell
col_snail_spiral.desc: A perfect spiral, pink at the lip.

col_solstice_bead.name: Solstice bead
col_solstice_bead.desc: Gold glass, warm in the hand.

col_stone_fossil.name: Fossil
col_stone_fossil.desc: A shell from before the sea left.

col_stone_obsidian.name: Obsidian
col_stone_obsidian.desc: Black glass from the Rite hills.

col_wool_tuft.name: Wool tuft
col_wool_tuft.desc: Caught on a thorn by the shepherds' path.

col_wren_feather.name: Wren feather
col_wren_feather.desc: Tiny and barred. Too small to fletch, too pretty to drop.

ing_acorn.name: Acorns
ing_acorn.desc: Bitter until leached. The hungry eat them anyway.

ing_ash_wood.name: Ash wood
ing_ash_wood.desc: Pale, straight-grained ash. The one wood the fae fear.

ing_bilberry.name: Bilberry
ing_bilberry.desc: Dusky berries that stain the fingers.

ing_birch_bark.name: Birch bark
ing_birch_bark.desc: Papery bark that lights even when damp.

ing_blackberry.name: Blackberry
ing_blackberry.desc: In winter, a few shrivelled berries still on the cane. In Spring, hedges heavy with them.

ing_blighted_petals.name: Blighted petals
ing_blighted_petals.desc: Grey petals that crumble like ash.

ing_chaga.name: Chaga
ing_chaga.desc: A charred-looking growth on birch; makes a warming tea.

ing_chalk.name: Chalk
ing_chalk.desc: Soft white stone; a white for painting.

ing_charcoal.name: Charcoal
ing_charcoal.desc: From the burnt estate's beams. Draws, and burns again.

ing_clay.name: Clay
ing_clay.desc: Riverbank clay for sealing and for binding pigment.

ing_clover.name: Clover
ing_clover.desc: Sweet pink heads in the grass.

ing_cornflower.name: Cornflower
ing_cornflower.desc: The bluest blue in the meadows.

ing_cowslip.name: Cowslip
ing_cowslip.desc: Nodding yellow bells on the downs.

ing_crocus.name: Crocus
ing_crocus.desc: The first purple through the leaf litter.

ing_dead_chicken.name: Dead chicken
ing_dead_chicken.desc: From the manor kitchen's larder. Bait for something that can't resist fresh meat.

ing_dreamcap.name: Dreamcap
ing_dreamcap.desc: A pale mushroom that only shows at night.

ing_elderflower.name: Elderflower
ing_elderflower.desc: Creamy umbels at the orchard's edge.

ing_ember_maple_leaf.name: Ember maple leaf
ing_ember_maple_leaf.desc: A leaf from over the Autumn border, warm to touch.

ing_faelight_dandelion.name: Faelight dandelion
ing_faelight_dandelion.desc: Its seeds drift off as little lights.

ing_flint.name: Flint
ing_flint.desc: Knaps into arrowheads, and strikes sparks.

ing_foxglove.name: Foxglove
ing_foxglove.desc: Beautiful and poisonous. For steeps, not stews.

ing_frozen_reed.name: Frozen reeds
ing_frozen_reed.desc: Hollow reeds locked in the river ice; good for snare work and whistles.

ing_glowcap.name: Glowcap
ing_glowcap.desc: A mushroom that gives off a soft green light.

ing_grey_lichen.name: Grey lichen
ing_grey_lichen.desc: Creeps over everything in the blight.

ing_hare_pelt.name: Hare pelt
ing_hare_pelt.desc: A soft pelt; lines a glove.

ing_hawk_feather.name: Hawk feather
ing_hawk_feather.desc: Stiff barred flight feather. True fletching.

ing_hawthorn_haw.name: Hawthorn haws
ing_hawthorn_haw.desc: Mealy red haws left on the hedge for the birds.

ing_hazelnut.name: Hazelnuts
ing_hazelnut.desc: A squirrel's cache, found under the snow.

ing_hide.name: Deer hide
ing_hide.desc: Scraped and sold, or kept against the cold.

ing_hollow_root.name: Hollow-root
ing_hollow_root.desc: A pale root that swallows sound and scent.

ing_holly_berry.name: Holly berries
ing_holly_berry.desc: Bright and poisonous. The red is worth crushing for paint.

ing_honey.name: Honey
ing_honey.desc: Sweetness, and a binder for salves.

ing_ice_moss.name: Ice moss
ing_ice_moss.desc: Silvery moss in the river's frozen spray.

ing_iron_filings.name: Iron filings
ing_iron_filings.desc: Villagers swear iron wards off faeries. It doesn't; only humans believe it.

ing_juniper_berry.name: Juniper berries
ing_juniper_berry.desc: Resinous blue berries that clear the head.

ing_madder.name: Madder root
ing_madder.desc: A root that bleeds red dye.

ing_marsh_marigold.name: Marsh marigold
ing_marsh_marigold.desc: Gold cups at the lake margins.

ing_meadowsweet.name: Meadowsweet
ing_meadowsweet.desc: Frothy cream flowers in damp meadows.

ing_mirror_reed.name: Mirror reed
ing_mirror_reed.desc: Reeds that hold a reflection a moment too long.

ing_mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
ing_mistletoe.desc: Villagers say the fae love it. Feyre leaves it where it grows, mostly.

ing_moonflower.name: Moonflower
ing_moonflower.desc: Opens only at night by the Starlight Pool.

ing_mugwort.name: Mugwort
ing_mugwort.desc: Grows thick around the old shrines.

ing_nightshade.name: Nightshade
ing_nightshade.desc: Purple berries at the blight's edge.

ing_oak_gall.name: Oak gall
ing_oak_gall.desc: Hard little galls; good for ink.

ing_old_mans_beard.name: Old man's beard
ing_old_mans_beard.desc: Grey-green lichen streaming from old branches; packs a wound.

ing_owl_feather.name: Owl feather
ing_owl_feather.desc: Soft-edged. An arrow fletched with it barely whispers.

ing_pine_needles.name: Pine needles
ing_pine_needles.desc: A bitter, bright tea against the cold.

ing_pine_resin.name: Pine resin
ing_pine_resin.desc: Amber resin for fletching glue and torches.

ing_red_ochre.name: Red ochre
ing_red_ochre.desc: Earth red from the riverbank cut.

ing_rite_spring.name: Rite spring water
ing_rite_spring.desc: From the spring in the cave of the Rite.

ing_river_silt.name: River silt
ing_river_silt.desc: Fine silt; an ochre pigment and a binder.

ing_rose_gold.name: Gold rose
ing_rose_gold.desc: Rare, deep in the gardens. The colour of a certain mask.

ing_rose_hip.name: Rose hips
ing_rose_hip.desc: Hips only form where time moves: winter hedges, and the blight's edge in Spring.

ing_rose_maze_dew.name: Rose-maze dew
ing_rose_maze_dew.desc: Morning dew gathered in the hedge maze.

ing_rose_red.name: Red rose
ing_rose_red.desc: The court's signature bloom. Warm in the hand, somehow.

ing_rose_white.name: White rose
ing_rose_white.desc: Cool petals that settle a racing pulse.

ing_rowan_berry.name: Rowan berry
ing_rowan_berry.desc: Bright clusters at the autumn edge.

ing_salt.name: Salt
ing_salt.desc: Bought dear at the market. Keeps meat through the winter.

ing_shed_antler.name: Shed antler
ing_shed_antler.desc: Dropped by a stag. Carves into toggles, handles, even points.

ing_snail_shell.name: Snail shells
ing_snail_shell.desc: Ground fine, they make a pearly white.

ing_snowdrop.name: Snowdrop
ing_snowdrop.desc: The only flower in the winter forest. Feyre always notices them.

ing_snowmelt_water.name: Snowmelt water
ing_snowmelt_water.desc: Melted over the fire, it is the base of every stew.

ing_spider_silk.name: Spider silk
ing_spider_silk.desc: Dewy silk from the thorn brakes. Twisted, it makes a fine strong line.

ing_starlight_water.name: Starlight water
ing_starlight_water.desc: Water from the pool at night. Gone flat and ordinary by dawn.

ing_sweet_woodruff.name: Sweet woodruff
ing_sweet_woodruff.desc: Smells of new hay once dried.

ing_thornbriar_sap.name: Thornbriar sap
ing_thornbriar_sap.desc: Sticky, bitter sap from the thorn brakes.

ing_tinder_fungus.name: Tinder fungus
ing_tinder_fungus.desc: Hoof-shaped bracket that holds an ember for hours.

ing_trout.name: Trout
ing_trout.desc: Speckled trout from the streams, or through the river ice.

ing_violet.name: Sweet violet
ing_violet.desc: Shy purple flowers in the glen.

ing_watermint.name: Water mint
ing_watermint.desc: Crushed underfoot at the stream's edge.

ing_wild_garlic.name: Wild garlic
ing_wild_garlic.desc: Carpets the shade; smells for miles.

ing_wild_strawberry.name: Wild strawberry
ing_wild_strawberry.desc: Tiny, sun-warm, everywhere in the meadows.

ing_willow_bark.name: Willow bark
ing_willow_bark.desc: Stream-bank bark that dulls pain when steeped.

ing_wintergreen.name: Wintergreen
ing_wintergreen.desc: Glossy leaves under the snow, with a sharp minty bite.

ing_wisteria.name: Wisteria
ing_wisteria.desc: Lilac drapes over the manor walls.

ing_woad.name: Woad
ing_woad.desc: Dried leaves that make a deep blue.

ing_wolf_pelt.name: Wolf pelt
ing_wolf_pelt.desc: A grey winter pelt. Worth good coin at the market.

obj_wolf_pelt.name: The great wolf's pelt
obj_wolf_pelt.desc: Too big for any wolf. It sells for more than she's seen in years.
